params.tomlComment: 自定义工具头收起 G-code
params.descEn: Custom command used to unmount the glue pen; supports the [AUTO] variable

params.desc: 开启后移除第三层裹头检测段。仅对A1/A1 mini机型有效
params.label: 关闭第三层裹头检测
params.tomlComment: 关闭第三层裹头检测(A1/A1 mini)
params.descEn: Removes the third-layer clog detection section. Only applies to A1 / A1 mini

params.desc: 开启后将强制关闭前盖脱落报警。仅对P1系列机型有效
params.label: 强制关闭前盖脱落报警
params.tomlComment: 关闭第三层裹头检测(A1/A1 mini)
params.descEn: Forces the front cover detached alarm off. Only applies to the P1 series

params.desc: 开启后移除延时摄影段(SKIPTYPE: timelapse)。仅对i3结构的A系列机型有效
params.label: 关闭延时摄影
params.tomlComment: 关闭延时摄影(A系列i3结构)
params.descEn: Removes the timelapse section (SKIPTYPE: timelapse). Only applies to i3-style A-series machines

params.desc: 每层圆盘旋转偏移的角度（0-30°）
params.label: 错开角度
params.tomlComment: 圆盘错开角度(度) 范围:0~30
params.descEn: Rotation offset applied to the disc every layer (0-30 deg)

params.desc: 摆动的最大偏移角度（10-90°）
params.label: 最大偏移角度
params.tomlComment: 圆盘最大偏移角度(度) 范围:10~90
params.descEn: Maximum swing offset angle (10-90 deg)

params.desc: 关闭：不旋转 | 开启：始终错开 | 自动：小层高时自动错开
params.label: 错开模式
params.descEn: Off: no rotation | On: always stagger | Auto: stagger only at small layer heights

params.desc: 旋转楼梯：单向累加到达最大值后回卷 | 锯齿摆动：到最大值后反向折返
params.label: 摆动模式
params.descEn: Spiral stairs: accumulate in one direction, then wrap around at the maximum | Sawtooth swing: reverse direction at the maximum

params.desc: 风扇 PWM 速度 (0-255)，控制冷却风量
params.label: 风扇速度
params.descEn: Fan PWM speed (0-255), controls the cooling airflow

params.desc: 快速：最大层高打印，仅涂胶面层慢速擦嘴 | 跟随模型：层高与模型一致 | 自定义：自定义层高和擦嘴策略
params.label: 擦料塔速度与质量
params.descEn: Fast: print at the maximum layer height, wipe slowly only on glue layers | Follow model: layer height matches the model | Custom: custom layer height and wipe strategy

params.desc: 在擦料塔的首层涂胶激活胶笔出胶，仅在开启擦料塔时有效
params.label: 首笔活化
params.descEn: Activates the glue pen while gluing the first layer of the wipe tower; only effective when the tower is enabled

params.desc: 模型间跳转 + 段间跳转微抬合并控制。涂胶区域间移动和段间跳转均使用此高度
params.label: 涂胶区域间Z轴抬升高度
params.tomlComment: 模型间/段间跳转Z抬升高度(mm) 范围:2~5
params.descEn: Combined hop control for inter-model travel and segment hops. Both use this height

params.desc: 同一区域的涂胶遍数，多次涂胶可增加粘合力但延长打印时间
params.label: 涂胶次数
params.descEn: Number of glue passes over the same area; more passes improve adhesion but take longer

params.desc: 小喷嘴(≤0.3mm)涂胶路径稀疏比例，0=不稀疏，50=隔行删除(默认)，100=仅保留首尾
params.label: 涂胶稀疏比
params.descEn: Sparsity of the glue path with a small nozzle (<=0.3mm): 0 = no sparsity, 50 = drop every other line (default), 100 = keep only the ends

params.desc: 热床模式下后左角的 Z 补偿值。负值=下压（涂胶笔更近床面，胶更多）；正值=上抬。补偿范围自动外扩 2mm 避免边缘突变
params.label: 热床-后左补偿
params.tomlComment: 热床后左角Z补偿 范围:-0.2~0.2
params.descEn: Z trim at the rear left corner in bed mode. Negative = press down (pen closer to the bed, more glue); positive = lift. The trim area extends by 2mm automatically to avoid a hard edge

params.desc: 热床模式下后右角的 Z 补偿值。负值=下压（涂胶笔更近床面，胶更多）；正值=上抬。补偿范围自动外扩 2mm 避免边缘突变
params.label: 热床-后右补偿
params.tomlComment: 热床后右角Z补偿 范围:-0.2~0.2
params.descEn: Z trim at the rear right corner in bed mode. Negative = press down (pen closer to the bed, more glue); positive = lift. The trim area extends by 2mm automatically to avoid a hard edge

params.desc: 热床模式下前左角的 Z 补偿值。负值=下压（涂胶笔更近床面，胶更多）；正值=上抬。补偿范围自动外扩 2mm 避免边缘突变
params.label: 热床-前左补偿
params.tomlComment: 热床前左角Z补偿 范围:-0.2~0.2
params.descEn: Z trim at the front left corner in bed mode. Negative = press down (pen closer to the bed, more glue); positive = lift. The trim area extends by 2mm automatically to avoid a hard edge

params.desc: 热床模式下前右角的 Z 补偿值。负值=下压（涂胶笔更近床面，胶更多）；正值=上抬。补偿范围自动外扩 2mm 避免边缘突变
params.label: 热床-前右补偿
params.tomlComment: 热床前右角Z补偿 范围:-0.2~0.2
params.descEn: Z trim at the front right corner in bed mode. Negative = press down (pen closer to the bed, more glue); positive = lift. The trim area extends by 2mm automatically to avoid a hard edge

params.desc: 开启后涂胶 Z 会根据 X/Y 位置按 4 角补偿值进行双线性插值，解决特定方向涂不上胶的问题。补偿范围自动外扩 2mm 避免边缘突变
params.label: 涂胶方向补偿
params.tomlComment: 涂胶方向补偿开关: false=关闭, true=开启(按4角双线性插值)
params.descEn: When on, the glue Z is interpolated bilinearly from the four corner trims by X/Y position, fixing directions where the glue does not stick. The trim area extends by 2mm automatically to avoid a hard edge

params.desc: 热床范围：针对整个热床物理面积补偿，适合床面本身倾斜（范围 ±0.2mm，外扩 2mm）；涂胶面范围：针对每层每个连续涂胶区域的包围盒补偿，适合模型局部不平（范围 ±0.1mm，外扩 2mm）
params.label: 补偿范围模式
params.tomlComment: 补偿范围模式: bed=热床范围(±0.2mm), patch=涂胶面范围(±0.1mm)
params.descEn: Bed range: compensate over the whole physical bed, for a bed that is itself tilted (range +/-0.2mm, extended 2mm) | Glue-area range: compensate per continuous glue area on each layer, for locally uneven models (range +/-0.1mm, extended 2mm)

params.desc: 涂胶面模式下后左角的 Z 补偿值。每块涂胶区域的包围盒自动外扩 2mm 作为补偿范围。负值=下压；正值=上抬
params.label: 涂胶面-后左补偿
params.tomlComment: 涂胶面后左角Z补偿 范围:-0.1~0.1
params.descEn: Z trim at the rear left corner in glue-area mode. Each glue area bounding box extends by 2mm to define the trim range. Negative = press down; positive = lift

params.desc: 涂胶面模式下后右角的 Z 补偿值。每块涂胶区域的包围盒自动外扩 2mm 作为补偿范围。负值=下压；正值=上抬
params.label: 涂胶面-后右补偿
params.tomlComment: 涂胶面后右角Z补偿 范围:-0.1~0.1
params.descEn: Z trim at the rear right corner in glue-area mode. Each glue area bounding box extends by 2mm to define the trim range. Negative = press down; positive = lift

params.desc: 涂胶面模式下前左角的 Z 补偿值。每块涂胶区域的包围盒自动外扩 2mm 作为补偿范围。负值=下压；正值=上抬
params.label: 涂胶面-前左补偿
params.tomlComment: 涂胶面前左角Z补偿 范围:-0.1~0.1
params.descEn: Z trim at the front left corner in glue-area mode. Each glue area bounding box extends by 2mm to define the trim range. Negative = press down; positive = lift

params.desc: 涂胶面模式下前右角的 Z 补偿值。每块涂胶区域的包围盒自动外扩 2mm 作为补偿范围。负值=下压；正值=上抬
params.label: 涂胶面-前右补偿
params.tomlComment: 涂胶面前右角Z补偿 范围:-0.1~0.1
params.descEn: Z trim at the front right corner in glue-area mode. Each glue area bounding box extends by 2mm to define the trim range. Negative = press down; positive = lift

params.desc: 涂胶前/后抬笔高度。换笔芯后涂胶前抬笔 + 涂胶结束抬笔使用此高度。前3层使用子参数'前3层抬升高度'
params.label: 涂胶Z轴抬升高度
params.tomlComment: 涂胶Z抬升高度(mm) 范围:5~10
params.descEn: Pen lift before and after gluing. Used for the hop after a pen refill and for the hop at the end of gluing. The first 3 layers use the first-3-layers lift sub-parameter

params.desc: 前3层涂胶前/后抬笔的额外高度，用于首层附着稳定。与涂胶Z轴抬升高度叠加使用
params.label: 前3层抬升高度
params.tomlComment: 前3层抬升高度(mm) 范围:6~10
params.descEn: Extra pen lift before and after gluing on the first 3 layers, to stabilize first-layer adhesion. Added on top of the glue Z hop height

params.desc: 换笔时喷嘴离开刚打完表面的高度（z-hop）。只影响那一次小螺旋脱层，不是抬笔高度
params.label: 换笔脱层高度
params.tomlComment: 换笔脱层高度(mm) 范围:0.2~3
params.descEn: How far the nozzle leaves the freshly printed surface during a pen swap (z-hop). Affects only that small spiral detach, not the pen lift height

params.desc: 涂胶时Z轴额外偏移，负值使笔尖更靠近模型表面
params.label: 涂胶Z偏移
params.descEn: Extra Z offset while gluing; negative brings the pen closer to the model surface

params.desc: 选择擦料方式：擦料塔在指定位置生成塔体进行擦拭；圆盘擦拭使用打印机自带圆盘
params.label: 擦料方式
params.tomlComment: 使用擦嘴塔而非擦嘴组件
params.descEn: How to wipe: the wipe tower builds a tower at a fixed position; disc wiping uses the printer built-in disc

params.desc: 熨烫面占支撑面的最低路径长度比例，低于此值时回退到支撑面
params.label: 熨烫覆盖阈值
params.tomlComment: 熨烫覆盖率阈值(%) 范围:0~100
params.descEn: Minimum share of the ironing surface covered by the support surface; below it the glue falls back to the support surface

params.desc: 当熨烫段挤出总量超过此阈值时自动移除熨烫（仅在自动模式下生效）
params.label: 熨烫挤出阈值
params.tomlComment: 熨烫E总和阈值 范围:0~100
params.descEn: Ironing is removed automatically when the extruded length of an ironing segment exceeds this threshold (auto mode only)

params.desc: 控制支撑面上层熨烫的保留/移除：关闭=始终移除熨烫挤出；开启=始终保留；自动=根据挤出量阈值判断
params.label: 支撑面熨烫
params.tomlComment: 熨烫模式: off=始终移除, on=始终保留, auto=自动判断
params.descEn: Keep or remove ironing on top of the support surface: off = always remove ironing extrusion; on = always keep; auto = decide by the extrusion threshold

params.desc: 已激活熨烫段包围盒向外扩展的距离，0为关闭扩展
params.label: 熨烫抑制扩展范围
params.tomlComment: 熨烫抑制扩展(mm) 范围:0~20
params.descEn: How far the bounding box of an active ironing segment expands outwards; 0 = no expansion

params.desc: 熨烫抑制区域的扩展方式：包围盒外扩=沿XY轴均匀外扩；质心半径外扩=从质心向外径向扩展
params.label: 熨烫抑制扩展模式
params.descEn: How the suppression area expands: bounding box = evenly along X and Y; centroid radius = radially outwards from the centroid

params.desc: 启用后过滤掉过小的支撑涂胶面，避免无效涂胶
params.label: 最小支撑涂胶面过滤
params.descEn: Filters out support glue areas that are too small, avoiding wasted glue

params.desc: 涂胶期间降低喷嘴温度以防止胶水因过热而滴漏
params.label: 涂胶期间降温
params.descEn: Lowers the nozzle temperature while gluing so the glue does not drip from overheating

params.desc: 涂胶笔尖相对喷嘴的 X 方向偏移量 (mm)，负值向左正值向右
params.label: X 轴偏移
params.descEn: X offset of the glue pen tip relative to the nozzle (mm); negative is left, positive is right

params.desc: 涂胶笔尖相对喷嘴的 Y 方向偏移量 (mm)，根据实际机械结构校准
params.label: Y 轴偏移
params.descEn: Y offset of the glue pen tip relative to the nozzle (mm); calibrate against the real hardware

params.desc: 涂胶笔尖相对喷嘴的高度偏移 (mm)，影响笔尖与模型的距离
params.label: Z 轴偏移
params.descEn: Height offset of the glue pen tip (mm); affects the distance between the pen and the model

params.desc: 选择擦料塔外围结构类型：无=不生成外围；斜肋外墙=在塔外侧生成斜肋支撑；护套=包裹塔体外围防止倒塌
params.label: 外围结构
params.descEn: Outer structure of the wipe tower: none = no outer shell; ribbed wall = angled ribs outside the tower; sheath = wrap the tower to keep it from collapsing

params.desc: 润笔总开关，关闭后所有润笔相关参数不显示且润笔逻辑不执行
params.label: 启用润笔
params.descEn: Master switch for priming; when off, all priming parameters are hidden and the priming logic is skipped

params.desc: 开启后每层涂胶前都触发润笔，与润笔触发层数互斥
params.label: 每层润笔
params.descEn: Primes before gluing on every layer; mutually exclusive with the priming trigger layer count

params.desc: 长时间未涂胶后重新润笔的路径长度，确保胶水充分流出
params.label: 润笔路径长度
params.descEn: Path length of a re-prime after a long time without gluing, ensuring the glue flows

params.desc: 触发润笔的最小路径长度阈值，路径长度小于此值时不触发润笔
params.label: 润笔最小路径长度
params.tomlComment: 润笔最小路径长度(mm) 范围:0~100
params.descEn: Path lengths below this threshold do not trigger priming

params.desc: 开启后每个模型的涂胶前都执行润笔，关闭则每层只润笔一次
params.label: 每个模型都润笔
params.descEn: Primes before gluing each model; when off, priming happens only once per layer

params.desc: 超过此层数未涂胶时自动触发润笔
params.label: 润笔触发层数
params.tomlComment: 预涂触发层数 范围:0~999
params.descEn: Priming is triggered automatically after this many layers without gluing

params.desc: 斜肋外墙的额外延伸长度，0为不延伸
params.label: 斜肋额外长度
params.tomlComment: 斜肋额外长度(mm) 范围:0~300
params.descEn: Extra extension length of the ribbed wall; 0 = no extension

params.desc: 斜肋外墙是否倒圆角
params.label: 外墙倒圆角
params.descEn: Whether the ribbed outer wall is rounded

params.desc: 斜肋外墙的宽度
params.label: 斜肋宽度
params.descEn: Width of the ribbed outer wall

params.desc: 护套底层相对塔体的单边膨胀量
params.label: 护套底层膨胀量
params.descEn: Single-side expansion of the sheath over the tower body on the bottom layer

params.desc: 护套从底层膨胀逐渐收敛到塔体外轮廓的层数
params.label: 护套收敛层数
params.descEn: Number of layers over which the sheath converges from the base expansion back to the tower outline

params.desc: 自动模式下，模型高度超过此值时启用护套
params.label: 护套自动启用高度
params.descEn: In auto mode the sheath is enabled once the model is taller than this

params.desc: 护套壁的宽度
params.label: 护套壁宽
params.descEn: Wall width of the sheath

params.desc: 小特征速度系数 = MaxSpeed × 此值。值越小(如0.5)小特征越精细但更慢
params.label: 小特征因子
params.descEn: Small-feature speed = MaxSpeed x this value. Lower (e.g. 0.5) is finer but slower

params.desc: 涂胶笔的最大移动速度 (mm/s)，过高可能导致涂胶不均匀或丢步
params.label: 涂胶速度限制
params.descEn: Maximum travel speed of the glue pen (mm/s); too high may cause uneven glue or lost steps

params.desc: 支撑材料的挤出倍率，影响支撑密度和拆除难度
params.label: 支撑挤出倍率
params.descEn: Extrusion multiplier for support material; affects support density and how easy it is to remove

params.desc: 自定义模式下的擦料塔层高策略
params.label: 塔层高策略
params.descEn: Wipe tower layer height strategy in custom mode

params.desc: 擦料塔出胶量比例，值越大出胶越多。会被处理器动态计算覆盖
params.label: 擦料塔挤出倍率
params.descEn: Glue output ratio of the wipe tower; higher means more glue. Overridden by the processor at runtime

params.desc: 擦料塔首层护套和斜肋的挤出流量比例，1.0为标准流量
params.label: 擦料塔首层流量
params.tomlComment: 擦料塔首层流量 范围:0.5~2
params.descEn: Extrusion flow ratio for the sheath and ribs on the first layer; 1.0 is the standard flow

params.desc: 涂胶面层的塔体打印速度
params.label: 涂胶面层速度
params.descEn: Tower print speed on glue layers

params.desc: 跟随塔：使用塔体打印速度 | 自定义：指定斜肋打印速度
params.label: 斜肋打印速度
params.descEn: Follow tower: use the tower print speed | Custom: use a specific rib print speed

params.desc: 斜肋外墙的自定义打印速度
params.label: 自定义速度
params.descEn: Custom print speed for the ribbed outer wall

params.desc: 擦料塔安全Z偏移距离，范围0.3~5.0mm
params.label: 塔安全Z偏移
params.descEn: Safety Z offset for the wipe tower, 0.3-5.0mm

params.desc: 护套的打印速度
params.label: 护套打印速度
params.descEn: Print speed of the sheath

params.desc: 擦料塔刮擦移动速度，范围50~500mm/s
params.label: 塔刮擦速度
params.descEn: Travel speed of the tower wipe, 50-500mm/s

params.desc: 开启：每层都擦嘴 | 关闭：包括涂胶面都不擦 | 自动：仅涂胶面层擦嘴
params.label: 擦嘴策略
params.descEn: On: wipe every layer | Off: no wipe, not even on glue layers | Auto: wipe only on glue layers

params.desc: 开启后，涂胶面优先使用熨烫段的 XY 路径；熨烫覆盖不足的区域自动回退到支撑面路径
params.label: 涂胶面使用熨烫路径
params.tomlComment: 使用熨烫路径作为涂胶路径
params.descEn: When on, glue follows the XY path of the ironing segment first; areas with too little ironing fall back to the support surface path

params.desc: 涂胶后额外等待干燥的时间 (秒)，让胶水充分固化
params.label: 额外干燥时间
params.descEn: Extra drying time after gluing (seconds) so the glue sets

params.desc: 擦料塔在热床上的X坐标位置 (mm)
params.label: 擦料塔X坐标
params.descEn: X position of the wipe tower on the bed (mm)

params.desc: 擦料塔在热床上的Y坐标位置 (mm)
params.label: 擦料塔Y坐标
params.descEn: Y position of the wipe tower on the bed (mm)

params.desc: 非涂胶面层的塔体打印速度
params.label: 塔体打印速度
params.descEn: Tower print speed on non-glue layers

params.desc: XY校准模式：默认或新型
params.label: XY校准模式
params.descEn: XY calibration mode: original uses fixed coordinates per machine; new generates them from the model position on the bed (default)

params.desc: Z校准模式：默认或新型
params.label: Z校准模式
params.descEn: Z calibration mode: original uses fixed coordinates per machine; new generates them from the model position on the bed (default)
